content: You wish to downgrade the team to <1>{{usersCount}}</1> admins, and current number of such users in the workspace is <1>{{currentUsersCount}}</1>.

comment.text: Informational text in the ChangePricingPlanDialog that warns about admin limit discrepancies when downgrading a plan; includes `<1>` tags for formatting and numeric variables `usersCount` (new limit) and `currentUsersCount` (existing admins).
